identitySignals: The organization's own website (corelearn.com) names itself 'CORE Learning (Consortium on Reaching Excellence in Education)', matching the agenda name exactly

Its services (K-12 literacy and math professional learning) match OUSD's 'Classroom & academic programs' contracts from the Chief Academic Officer, including a literacy coach/reading specialist funding source

Search listings place the organization at 1300 Clay St, Oakland, CA, matching the agenda's Oakland location, but its current website lists a San Francisco mailing address and says it merged into other organizations (Pivot Learning 2017, UnboundEd 2022), so the current legal entity is unclear
research.notes: Could not confirm the current legal entity or registry IDs: ProPublica was rate-limited, and CA Secretary of State and SAM.gov were not checked. CORE's website says it joined Pivot Learning (2017) and merged with UnboundEd (2022), so the contracting entity may differ from the original Oakland-based 'Consortium on Reaching Excellence in Education, Inc.'. The website's contact page shows a San Francisco PMB mailing address (548 Market St), not Oakland, so address and headquarters were left null. Third-party listings (Yelp etc.) show 1300 Clay St, Oakland but were not used. A reviewer should confirm the entity against the OUSD contract.

profile.summary: CORE Learning, also known as the Consortium on Reaching Excellence in Education (CORE), provides professional learning for K-12 teachers and school leaders. Its programs focus on teaching reading, writing and math, including structured literacy training. It was founded in California in 1995 and works with school districts in many states.
